build_levenshtein_transformer_model: build a LevenshteinTransformerModel for non-autoregressive translation using insertion and deletion operations
build_levenshtein_decoder: build a LevenshteinTransformerDecoder with separate mask insertion, word insertion, and word deletion heads
run_forward_training: run the forward pass to compute mask insertion, word insertion, and word deletion outputs for training
run_iterative_decoding: run iterative decoding with forward_decoder to delete, insert masks, and insert words step by step
configure_levenshtein_architecture: configure a Levenshtein transformer architecture with early exit layers and optional shared discriminator parameters
